notices.diversFull: Every diver’s seat on this boat is taken. There’s still room for a snorkeler or a rider.
notices.typeChangeUnavailable: On a course session, students stay divers and nobody else becomes one. Use Remove booking, then seat them again as what they’ll do. Snorkelers and riders need a price on the session.
notices.typeUnavailable: On a course session, students stay divers and nobody else becomes one. Snorkelers and riders need a price on the session.
notices.restoreDiversFull: Couldn’t undo. Every diver’s seat has been taken since.
notices.noShowDiversFull: Couldn’t put them back. Every diver’s seat has been taken since.
notices.onBuddyTeam: Take them off their buddy team first. A buddy team is divers only.
notices.certBlocked: Their card for this trip isn’t on file. Check it first, or change anyway.
notices.closed: Too late for that change. Nothing changes once the boat is home.
notices.boardedNotReady: They’re aboard, and not ready to dive. Clear what’s blocking them first. Once the boat has left there’s no changing anyway.
notices.owed: Saved. Their seat costs more now, so they owe the difference.
